title: Test store updates through actions
summary: Implement cart actions as pure transitions, then design tests for duplicate adds, zero quantities, clearing, and mutation bugs.

scenario.briefing: The cart keeps a duplicate line after the same product is added twice, and clearing it does not update the badge. The team wants the store transitions tested first.

objectives.description: Implement store actions without mutating the current array.
Select the store tests that cover real behavior.

hints: Merge an add when the SKU already exists.
A quantity of zero or less removes the line.
Clear returns a new empty array.
Return a new array from every branch that changes the cart.

misconceptions.description: Appending a duplicate SKU instead of merging.
misconceptions.testDescription: Adding the same SKU increases its quantity.
misconceptions.feedback: A cart has one line per SKU. Merge the quantity so the badge and total stay correct.

misconceptions.description: Mutating the current array inside update.
misconceptions.testDescription: Setting a quantity returns a new array.
misconceptions.feedback: A mutated array keeps the same reference. Svelte may not notify subscribers, so derived values go stale.

misconceptions.description: Testing rendered HTML instead of transitions.
misconceptions.feedback: HTML snapshots do not prove merge or removal behavior. Test the reducer with a starting array and an action.

sections.title: Stores change through actions
sections.body: A writable store should be updated with set or update using a new value. Actions such as add, setQuantity, and clear keep the transition rules in one testable place.

sections.title: Test the reducer, then the component
sections.body: A pure reducer test proves duplicate SKUs merge and zero quantities remove a line. A component test then proves the store value reaches the markup.

sections.title: Mutation is invisible to subscribers
sections.body: Svelte compares the value returned by update. Mutating the current array keeps the same reference, so subscribers and derived stores may never see the change.

vocabulary.definition: A store with set and update methods.
A function that returns the next state for an action.

steps.title: Reduce cart store actions
steps.prompt: Edit cartActions.ts. Implement add, setQuantity, and clear. Merge duplicate SKUs, remove a line when quantity reaches zero, and return new arrays.
hints: Handle add by looking up the SKU first.
Merge a duplicate with a mapped array and a larger quantity.
For setQuantity, filter the line out when quantity <= 0.
For clear, return a new empty array.

steps.title: Design the store tests
steps.prompt: Select every case the cart store tests need. Leave out cases that assert mutation or markup.
hints: Cover merge, zero quantity, clear, and an unknown action.
Assert the returned array, not the input identity.
Reject mutation and HTML snapshot cases.

cases.label: Adding an existing SKU increases its quantity.
Setting a quantity to zero removes the line.
An unknown action leaves the current array unchanged.
Asserts that the original array was mutated in place.
Compares the rendered component as an HTML string.

steps.explanation: The store contract covers merge, zero-quantity removal, clear, and an unknown action. Mutation is the bug, and HTML snapshots do not exercise the reducer.
